sql:
SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0)::float, 3) as yt_per_angler,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 174 AND fish_date_doy <= 213
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 200
